mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months indicates rising inflation expectations, which would lead to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI growth does not lead to higher interest rates.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decline in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which would lead to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates rising economic activity, which would lead to higher demand for goods and services and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO growth does not lead to higher demand.

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months, combined with a 0.5% decline in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the same period, signals a strengthening housing market and a tightening labor market, which would lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 1% in 3 months and UNRATE falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening housing market and tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months, combined with a 1% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the same period, signals a tightening monetary cycle and rising inflation expectations, which would lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL rises > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS and CPI growth do not lead to higher interest rates.

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which would lead to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during an expansion regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during expansion regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) over the past 6 months signals rising economic activity, which would lead to higher demand for goods and services and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during a monetary easing cycle.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or GDPC1 growth does not lead to higher demand during monetary easing cycles.
